paragraphs.text:
They’re playing a form of whist. You hope to get information, 
but your winning streak quickly becomes phenomenal. Soon 
the fishermen grumble to themselves and stir unhappily. In 20 
minutes you clean out the table. Y ou win a total of $35, and stuff 
your pockets with small-denomination drachma notes. Return 
to the café at 20, or go to any Athens Location.
(107)
